delivery.render: Upload secret files at exact configured paths through the provider secret-file UI. Runtime and release secret scopes remain separate.
delivery.fly: Use [[files]] with secret_name. Base64 file content belongs in app secret store; never raw_value/committed TOML. Verify runtime file ownership/mode in live qualification.
delivery.cloud-run: Secret Manager env references deliver protected SPACEWORKS_*_B64 values. M materializes owned 0600 files before Django/admission, avoiding root-owned secret-volume mode assumptions in Jobs.
delivery.kubernetes: Existing config Secrets projected at exact subPath; managed fsGroup owns writable scratch only.
delivery.digitalocean: Supply protected SPACEWORKS_*_B64 values as encrypted RUN_TIME envs. M must call cloud_setup.secret_files.materialize_secret_files before Django/admission reads.
delivery.koyeb: Supply protected SPACEWORKS_*_B64 provider secrets. M must materialize before Django/admission reads.
delivery.railway: Supply protected SPACEWORKS_*_B64 service secrets. M must materialize before Django/admission reads.

inline_contract.selector: SPACEWORKS_SECRET_FILE_MODE=inline (explicit managed only; unset/native does nothing)
inline_contract.destination: Use /tmp/spaceworks-secrets/ with an owned 0700 directory and 0600 files; no symlinks.
inline_contract.startup: M integrates cloud_setup.secret_files.materialize_secret_files(environ) before importing Django/settings and before process admission; no default host changes
inline_contract.registration: I registers selector and both B64 values in ENV_SURFACE/backup secret policy; B64 values are write-only secrets
inline_contract.source_layout: Root scripts/cloud_setup packaged for setup/managed entrypoint import; include recipes at /app/deploy if rendering in an image.

publication_gate: No recipe is certified until actual mounted/materialized bytes, permissions and service transport pass live acceptance.
